title: Aurum Alpha structured log line
description: One JSON object per line, to stdout. Governed by standards/030-service.md SC2; the timestamp comes from the identifiers contract and the context block from the observability contract, referenced rather than restated. schemaVersion 1 — evolves additively per PC6.

level.description: Five levels, no more (SC2). The emitting threshold is configuration, never an environment the code detected.

msg.description: Names what happened precisely enough to be useful alone, and stably enough that lines about the same event group: 'mysql connect timeout', never 'db error' and never the whole incident inlined. A failure class such as 'invalid input' or 'internal error' may open the message but never be the whole of it — the specifics follow. Variable specifics belong in their own fields. The exception is a terminal fatal preceding an exit (SC6), where nothing downstream will query and a human reads raw stdout, so msg carries the whole diagnosis.

service.description: The service's stable name, identical to the provenance block's service (SC5).

error.description: Required on error and fatal lines (SC2): the reason, not the fact of failure. Names what failed and why, with the underlying cause preserved rather than replaced. Never carries a secret, a credential, or protected personal data — name the key and the record's public id, not the value and not the contents.

type.description: The specific failure class, as the runtime or the domain named it: an errno, an exception type, the constraint or validation rule violated. Never a generic wrapper type.

message.description: The underlying cause as received — the driver's message, the upstream status and reason, the timeout and its limit.

cause.description: Where this failure wrapped another, the cause it wrapped. The chain is preserved rather than replaced, because the outermost error is rarely the actionable one.

file.description: Source file where the error was constructed, relative to the module root when the runtime path contains the prefix the emitter was given. Omitted when the runtime did not record a frame. Paired with line.

line.description: 1-based line in file. Omitted together with file when the runtime did not record a frame.

allOf.description: file and line are one frame. A line number without a file, or a file without a line, is not a location.
OC4: within request context, the context block is required. A line carrying any request-scoped id must carry the floor pair.
SC2: an error or fatal line states a reason. The error object is where the reason lives, so a failure line without one is a notification that logging happened.
